files.content:
# Examples/Article comments

Reaction count chips plus a compact reactions bar that expands to the full picker.

Install emoji-picker-react 5 or later, import app.css and picker.css, then render <Shell className="comments-picker" />. For CSS Modules, import picker.module.css and pass styles.picker as className. The component includes its app context; adapt its insertion callback to your product.
